Description: Adversaries may attempt to dump credentials to obtain account login and credential material
Adversaries may use valid accounts to log into remote machines using services
Adversaries may inject code into processes in order to evade process-based defenses
Adversaries may abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands
Adversaries may obtain and abuse credentials of existing accounts as a means of gaining Initial Access
Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts when passwords are unknown
Adversaries may attempt to take advantage of a weakness in an Internet-facing computer or program
Adversaries may exploit remote services to gain unauthorized access to internal systems
Adversaries may execute their own malicious payloads by hijacking the way operating systems run programs
